reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Georgia
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Can a landlord evict a tenant for material falsification on the rental application?

    This program encodes the provided statutes:
      - GA Code  44-7-10 (2021)
      - GA Code  44-7-50 (2021)
      - GA Code  44-7-24 (2021) (retaliation defense framework)

    And encodes a scenario where the ONLY stated issue is material falsification on the
    rental application, with no lease expiration/holding-over, no nonpayment, and no at-will/sufferance.
*/

/* =========================
   Scenario Facts (question)
   ========================= */

state(georgia).
focus_year(2021).

landlord(l1).
tenant(t1).
property(p1).

% Landlord-tenant relationship exists (required for summary eviction per Carruth v. Carruth note under  44-7-10).
tenancy(l1, t1, p1).

% Lease status: fixed term, not expired; tenant is currently in possession.
tenancy_type(t1, p1, fixed_term).
tenant_in_possession(t1, p1).

% Rent is current (no nonpayment).
rent_due_for_period(p1, no).
rent_paid_current(p1, yes).

% Landlord desires possession and demanded it; tenant refused.
owner_of(l1, p1).
owner_desires_possession(l1, p1).

demand_for_possession_made(l1, t1, p1).
tenant_refused_or_failed_to_deliver_after_demand(t1, p1).

% The only "wrong" in the question: material falsification on the rental application.
material_falsification_on_rental_application(t1, p1).

/* A helper predicate that succeeds exactly when the encoded scenario matches. */
scenario_statement :-
    state(georgia),
    focus_year(2021),
    landlord(l1),
    tenant(t1),
    property(p1),
    tenancy(l1, t1, p1),
    tenancy_type(t1, p1, fixed_term),
    tenant_in_possession(t1, p1),
    rent_paid_current(p1, yes),
    owner_desires_possession(l1, p1),
    demand_for_possession_made(l1, t1, p1),
    tenant_refused_or_failed_to_deliver_after_demand(t1, p1),
    material_falsification_on_rental_application(t1, p1).

/* =========================
   Statute Translations
   ========================= */

/* --- GA Code  44-7-10 (2021)
   "Tenant shall deliver possession ... at expiration of his term; and if he fails/refuses, a summary remedy ... is given."
*/
statute_44_7_10_summary_remedy_available(Landlord, Tenant, Property) :-
    tenancy(Landlord, Tenant, Property),
    lease_term_expired(Tenant, Property, yes),
    tenant_in_possession(Tenant, Property),
    !.

/* We model lease expiration as a fact; in this scenario it is not expired. */
lease_term_expired(Tenant, Property, yes) :-
    lease_expired_fact(Tenant, Property, yes),
    !.
lease_term_expired(Tenant, Property, no) :-
    lease_expired_fact(Tenant, Property, no),
    !.

/* Scenario-provided: not expired. */
lease_expired_fact(t1, p1, no).

/* --- GA Code  44-7-50 (2021)
   Dispossessory demand/affidavit process is available when:
     (a) tenant holds over beyond term, OR
     (b) fails to pay rent when due, OR
     (c) is tenant at will or sufferance,
   AND owner desires possession,
   AND owner demands possession,
   AND tenant refuses/fails to deliver after demand.
*/

% Condition (a): holds over beyond term
statute_44_7_50_holds_over(Tenant, Property) :-
    tenant_in_possession(Tenant, Property),
    lease_term_expired(Tenant, Property, yes),
    !.

% Condition (b): fails to pay rent when it becomes due
statute_44_7_50_fails_to_pay_rent(Property) :-
    rent_due_for_period(Property, yes),
    rent_paid_current(Property, no),
    !.

% Condition (c): tenant at will or sufferance
statute_44_7_50_tenant_at_will_or_sufferance(Tenant, Property) :-
    tenancy_type(Tenant, Property, at_will),
    !.
statute_44_7_50_tenant_at_will_or_sufferance(Tenant, Property) :-
    tenancy_type(Tenant, Property, at_sufferance),
    !.

% Aggregate "statutory grounds" for  44-7-50
statute_44_7_50_ground_exists(Tenant, Property) :-
    statute_44_7_50_holds_over(Tenant, Property),
    !.
statute_44_7_50_ground_exists(_Tenant, Property) :-
    statute_44_7_50_fails_to_pay_rent(Property),
    !.
statute_44_7_50_ground_exists(Tenant, Property) :-
    statute_44_7_50_tenant_at_will_or_sufferance(Tenant, Property),
    !.

% Full  44-7-50 dispossessory availability (demand + refusal + statutory ground + ownership/desire).
statute_44_7_50_dispossessory_available(Landlord, Tenant, Property) :-
    owner_of(Landlord, Property),
    owner_desires_possession(Landlord, Property),
    statute_44_7_50_ground_exists(Tenant, Property),
    demand_for_possession_made(Landlord, Tenant, Property),
    tenant_refused_or_failed_to_deliver_after_demand(Tenant, Property),
    !.

/* --- GA Code  44-7-24 (2021) Retaliation defense framework.
   In this question's scenario, there are no tenant protected actions or timing facts.
   We still encode the structure so reasoning is complete and non-hardcoded.
*/

% Tenant protected actions (subset; modeled generally).
tenant_protected_action(_Tenant, _Property, exercised_right_or_remedy) :- fail.
tenant_protected_action(_Tenant, _Property, gave_notice_to_repair) :- fail.
tenant_protected_action(_Tenant, _Property, complained_to_government) :- fail.
tenant_protected_action(_Tenant, _Property, participated_in_tenant_org) :- fail.

% Landlord adverse actions (subset).
landlord_adverse_action(_Landlord, _Tenant, _Property, filed_dispossessory) :- fail.
landlord_adverse_action(_Landlord, _Tenant, _Property, terminated_lease) :- fail.
landlord_adverse_action(_Landlord, _Tenant, _Property, increased_rent) :- fail.
landlord_adverse_action(_Landlord, _Tenant, _Property, decreased_services) :- fail.
landlord_adverse_action(_Landlord, _Tenant, _Property, deprived_use) :- fail.
landlord_adverse_action(_Landlord, _Tenant, _Property, materially_interfered) :- fail.

% Timing model: months_between(ActionMonth, AdverseMonth, MonthsDiff).
months_between(M1, M2, Diff) :-
    integer(M1),
    integer(M2),
    Diff is M2 - M1.

within_three_months(ActionMonth, AdverseMonth) :-
    months_between(ActionMonth, AdverseMonth, Diff),
    Diff >= 0,
    Diff =< 3.

% Prima facie retaliation (requires tenant protected action AND landlord adverse action within 3 months).
statute_44_7_24_prima_facie_retaliation(Landlord, Tenant, Property) :-
    tenant_protected_action(Tenant, Property, _ActionType),
    landlord_adverse_action(Landlord, Tenant, Property, _AdverseType),
    tenant_action_month(Tenant, Property, M1),
    landlord_action_month(Landlord, Tenant, Property, M2),
    within_three_months(M1, M2),
    !.

% Exception safe-harbor / non-liability conditions (subset; structured).
% 44-7-24(d)(2) includes dispossessory/termination based on certain circumstances (e.g., delinquent rent, certain breaches).
% We encode a limited structure; scenario does not trigger it.
statute_44_7_24_nonliability_exception_applies(_Landlord, _Tenant, _Property) :- fail.

% Retaliation defense applies if prima facie case and no exception.
statute_44_7_24_retaliation_defense(Landlord, Tenant, Property) :-
    statute_44_7_24_prima_facie_retaliation(Landlord, Tenant, Property),
    \+ statute_44_7_24_nonliability_exception_applies(Landlord, Tenant, Property),
    !.

% Timing facts (not present in scenario; default absent).
tenant_action_month(_Tenant, _Property, _Month) :- fail.
landlord_action_month(_Landlord, _Tenant, _Property, _Month) :- fail.

/* =========================
   Legal Reasoning
   ========================= */

% Under the provided statutes, eviction via summary dispossessory process is supported when either:
%   - 44-7-10: term expired and tenant fails to deliver possession; OR
%   - 44-7-50: listed grounds + demand + refusal.
can_evict_under_provided_statutes(Landlord, Tenant, Property) :-
    statute_44_7_10_summary_remedy_available(Landlord, Tenant, Property),
    \+ statute_44_7_24_retaliation_defense(Landlord, Tenant, Property),
    !.
can_evict_under_provided_statutes(Landlord, Tenant, Property) :-
    statute_44_7_50_dispossessory_available(Landlord, Tenant, Property),
    \+ statute_44_7_24_retaliation_defense(Landlord, Tenant, Property),
    !.

% Key point for this question: "material falsification on the rental application" is NOT itself a listed
% dispossessory ground in 44-7-50, and 44-7-10 is tied to expiration of term.
% Therefore, unless it causes/aligns with those statutory predicates (e.g., termination + holding over),
% it does not, by itself, make eviction available under ONLY the provided statutes.

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    can_evict_under_provided_statutes(l1, t1, p1),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Can a landlord evict a tenant for material falsification on the rental application?
